remarks: Welcome to Bishop Meadows, a small residential enclave nestled in a wooded location directly across from Cummings Beach Park. This lovely 2 BR, 2.5 BTH tri-level townhome is freshly painted and features an eat-in kitchen, large living room with fireplace, deck and a large separate dining space and powder room on the main level. Kitchen equipped with brand new refrigerator, range, hood vent, dishwasher and sink faucet. Second level includes the ensuite primary bedroom with abundant closets and dual exposures, large second bedroom with abundant closets, plus additional full bath. Lower basement level has a very large play/accessory room with new flooring, built-in shelving and glass slider to exterior plus laundry room. This unit includes its own private garage. Unit 26 is one of two attached townhouses in a single family home.
